name: Atomic Eagle Limited
content: Atomic Eagle Limited is an Australian-based mineral exploration company focused on the discovery and development of high-grade uranium deposits. The company holds a significant land position in the world-class Athabasca Basin in Saskatchewan, Canada, which is renowned for hosting the highest-grade uranium mines globally. Atomic Eagle's primary focus is on its flagship projects where it utilizes modern geophysical techniques and targeted drilling programs to identify Tier-1 uranium assets. The company is committed to sustainable exploration practices and aims to contribute to the global transition toward clean energy through the supply of uranium.

Officers

Nader El-Sayed(Date: 2024 May)

Company Secretary

Mr El-Sayed is a Certified Practising Accountant and a Director of Multi-Purpose Business Solutions, a boutique accounting and business advisory firm. He has over 20 years of experience in the areas of corporate compliance, financial accounting, and taxation. He is also a Non-Executive Director of several ASX-listed companies.

Directors

David Wheeler(Date: 2024 May)

Non-Executive Chairman

Mr Wheeler has more than 30 years of Executive and Non-Executive Director experience in Australia and internationally. He is a Fellow of the Australian Institute of Company Directors and has experience in capital markets, corporate advisory, and strategic management.

Nader El-Sayed(Date: 2024 May)

Non-Executive Director

Mr El-Sayed is a Certified Practising Accountant and a Director of Multi-Purpose Business Solutions. He has over 20 years of experience in corporate compliance and financial accounting.

Joe Graziano(Date: 2024 May)

Non-Executive Director

Mr Graziano is a qualified Chartered Accountant with over 30 years of experience in corporate advisory and financial management. He has served as a director and company secretary for several ASX-listed companies.
